title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 11
topics: A Long and Healthy Life · The Generation Gap · Cities of the Future
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: What do you do to stay healthy?
How often do you talk with your grandparents?
What do you think cities will look like in the future?
What healthy habit would you like to start?
Do you think people will live longer in the future? Why?
What do you and your parents often disagree about? Why?
Do you think a smart city is a good place for teenagers? Why?
Is it a good idea to live with an extended family? Why?
Your grandmother doesn't know how to use a smartphone. How would you help her?
Your friend eats fast food every day. What advice would you give?
